svg.title: meta-research: how a run flows
svg.desc: Setup (init, prepare.py, program.md, designs/, seed) feeds a loop the agent runs in-session: inspect experience with suggest/context/recall/trajectory, optionally run a Co-Scientist ideation round, form one falsifiable hypothesis, write one design, run meta-research eval which scores, stores a bundle, updates frontier, kg and results.tsv and commits, then read the result and repeat. An append-only ledger is the shared store; sealed holdout scores are kept aside and revealed only by finalize.
svg.text: The framework is deterministic tooling. The agent (Claude Code following the skill) runs the loop in-session.
run by the agent in-session, every iteration, until interrupted
then Read the bundles: heatmap / diagnostics, hypothesis.md
suggest: draft · improve · debug · crossover; parent by
rank selection (T=0.2); stagnant parents are skipped
change exactly one mechanism; dry-run build() + feasibility

text.tspan: sealed holdout scores are split off →

svg.text: frontier extended? prediction confirmed or refuted?
Literature cards from papers, model cards and reports;
ideas = one mechanism + a falsifiable prediction
Reviews: initial · full · deep · simulation · observation,
each by an independent subagent; only 'pass' plays on
debate matches, new ideas vs. their most similar rival
Top ideas spawn new ideas (grounding, combination, …);
never edits: an evolved idea must win its own matches
Similarity clusters and near-duplicates; reject the
weaker duplicate, note the regions nobody has tried
Recurring problems in critiques and debates,
read at the start of every round
The top-rated untested idea becomes the hypothesis:
Evaluated ideas play reality matches decided by realized gain
stats: how often the judges agreed with reality (concordance)
realized gains move the Elo ratings
the shared store · the run dir is its own git repo · nothing is ever deleted

text.tspan: design.py · design_spec.json · hypothesis.md · result.json · trace/ (heatmap.png, fields, solver.log)

svg.text: experience loop: repeat, never stop, never git reset
reveals the sealed scores of the top-k candidates by search score and picks
the best on the holdout; reference points are never picked
